🦺 Labor & Workers' Rights
NH HB303 — NH Could Match OSHA Safety Rules

New Hampshire employers could soon face safety standards similar to those set by the federal Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA). This bill would require the state’s Department of Labor to review and adopt worker safety rules mirroring OSHA’s, including establishing up to 6 new inspector positions and annual reviews of those standards. ...
